metrics.definition: Number of records in neutral-bootstrap-1 validation violations; one invalid block can fail several checks.
metrics.eligibility: Complete terminal replay evidence under bootstrap-1 contracts; unavailable/invalid replay inputs yield NOT_MEASURED with null.
metrics.denominator: Not a rate. fixture.json#/tasks gives the task population; the default tiny fixture has 75 tasks.
metrics.exclusions: No run is deleted. Failed replay evidence is retained and explicitly unmeasured.
metrics.claim_boundary: Bootstrap checks only; not full hard-constraint validation, product correctness, accepted work or product performance.
